criteria.failure_priority: policy failure/incomplete-ended cycles precede actuator comparison; process/resource aborts are not policy failures
criteria.hardware_limit_basis: recorded simulation effort limits: first6 120Nm, feet27Nm, wheels40Nm; actual motor current/continuous/thermal limits are unknown
criteria.margin_layer_method: within the same motion hash, rank Pareto layers on worst normalized computed torque, foot computed-over-limit fraction, and worst applied shank torque; all minimize; retain ties with countermetrics
criteria.old_randomized_alias: randomized-no-push remains separately identified; its randomization is not assumed equal to current-randomized-no-push
criteria.peak_semantics: force is average net normal force over5ms, excluding friction; PD drive torque excludes passive/internal impact loads
criteria.priority_confirmed_by_user: failure risk and actuator headroom, then posture, landing load and tracking
criteria.relative_metric_limitations: This normalized RMS gap is not a percent of failed samples and not a percentage relative to one side; low-amplitude pairs can have high relative gaps, absolute values are retained.
criteria.sign_handling: main ranking uses magnitude gap; signed gaps provided with descriptive reference-fit sign; zero reference does not establish physical mirror sign
criteria.symmetry_hardware_acceptance: no numeric threshold approved; tiers are descriptive engineering advice, not hardware pass/fail
criteria.symmetry_order: retain approved failure/torque-margin priority and prior margin tiers; within each tier compare four worst-case symmetry/speed metrics; show all five joint pairs and their full vector as sensitivity, preserve countermetrics
criteria.symmetry_scope: all ten joints, five left-right pairs; no joint type omitted
criteria.symmetry_vector_sensitivity: Pareto check using five pair-specific phase torque gaps, five pair-specific velocity gaps, wheel contact asynchrony, and full-cycle wheel speed peak. It is not equivalent to all-metric optimality.
criteria.timing_symmetry_metric: worst full-cycle wheel contact time gap using existing 10N definition; 1N sensitivity retained
criteria.torque_symmetry_metric: worst case and command phase RMS(abs(applied_left)-abs(applied_right))/recorded pair effort limit, maximum over all five pairs
criteria.velocity_symmetry_metric: worst-case RMS(abs(left velocity)-abs(right velocity))/pooled pair RMS velocity; all five pairs; wheel uses only after both wheels first touchdown at10N, all other pairs use full successful cycle
criteria.wheel_speed_peak_metric: max abs measured left/right wheel velocity over full successful cycles, including pre-landing; lower is preferred even below saturation, no hardware pass threshold supplied
criteria.wheel_velocity_difference_exclusion: User explicitly excluded pre-landing differences. Only after the later of the two first10N wheel contacts enters wheel speed difference; full-cycle wheel absolute peak is retained separately.
